measurements.method: Compared the structural wall polygon built from the official feature ring using the repository transform; facade details and entrance are excluded from plan comparison
measurements.after_structural_shell: Built from all distinct official source-ring vertices; intended to match official footprint within coordinate conversion precision
measurements.position_status: Structural footprint set to the official map polygon coordinates; underlying source positional uncertainty is unpublished
measurements.plan_dimension_status: Structural wall ring is mapped from all ten official source polygon vertices. Project transform is approximate local XY; this is not a survey. Structural ring vertex max discrepancy after fresh-open validation is 0.000014 m from floating-point conversion.
measurements.orientation_status: GIS polygon orientation is followed exactly. A 128.544 degree ridge-axis approximation is selected from the polygon principal direction; the operator photo is not georeferenced, so facade-to-campus orientation remains unverified.
measurements.height_status: 6.7 m eaves and 10.2 m ridge are illustrative estimates based on two visible above-grade window rows and photo proportions. Official GIS reports NUM_LEVELS=1 and Extrution=17 without a field-unit/counting definition; no measured elevation is available.
measurements.storey_evidence: GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with both the operator photo-tour Floor Two label and the operator exterior image showing two above-grade window levels. The model uses two above-grade levels; the field counting convention and exact total levels remain unresolved.
measurements.interior_status: In-mesh lower/upper floorplates, a central corridor, room partition bays, and doorway gaps are modeled schematically. Official operator page reports 10 rooms and shared foyer, study, living/meeting room, bum room and dining room, but publishes no floor plan or partition locations; room layout is unverified.

geometry_edits: Replaced massing shell with exact official FID 800 footprint polygon, retaining asset path, object name, collection, scene and ID.
Modeled two-storey light-toned facade, six sash-window bays on the dominant gable elevation, dark shutters, sill/meeting rails, floor band and a low masonry/plinth base from owner photograph.
Added the three small gable vents, two window AC units, a two-level corner porch/balcony with posts, simple railing and a shallow canopy visible in the owner photo.
Rebuilt the roof as pitched surfaces clipped to the GIS outline; gable/ridge height and inferred roof-wing shape remain estimates.
Added procedural low-amplitude plaster and asphalt variation, glass, dark metal/shutter, stone, interior wall and floor materials; no external texture dependencies.
Added schematic floorplates, room bays, central hall and door openings inside the structural footprint; layout is explicitly not a verified floor plan.
uncertainties: The official campus polygon is not a certified survey and publishes no positional or dimensional uncertainty.
Official NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the operator Floor Two gallery label and exterior photo showing two above-grade window levels; field counting semantics and total levels remain unresolved.

The operator exterior reference is monochrome, dated 2016, unscaled and not georeferenced. Wall/roof colors, exact height, facade-to-campus orientation, roof-wing arrangement, porch placement, exact window spacing and trim dimensions remain estimated.
The owner site states 10 rooms and shared rooms but does not publish a floor plan; modeled partitions and doors are schematic and unverified.
No independent grader has reviewed the final mesh SHA; do not mark this asset accepted until a reviewer grades the exact SHA.

noted_limits: Interior is schematic with no as-built room plan and the cutaway is sparse.

Height, roof-wing composition, color, facade bearing and other unobserved details remain estimates.
